facts.fact: The FY2025/26 estimates allocate BWP 477,403,718 to the Ministry of Communications and Innovation's development project 11637 Research and Development, funded from the Domestic Development Fund (revised in August 2025 to BWP 185,786,978).
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation, project 11637 Research and Development, FY2025/26

facts.fact: Actual expenditure on project 11637 was BWP 42,771,544 at 5 December 2025, 23.0 percent of the revised BWP 185,786,978; a part-year figure, not a full-year outturn.
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation, project 11637 Research and Development, FY2025/26

note: No year-on-year comparison given in this document, so no rose or fell fact.
